LESSON: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are careers important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension helps you succeed in INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING 7.2.1 READING COMPREHENSION
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are careers important?
2. How can we ensure we summarise information accurately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading 7.2.1 Reading Comprehension means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the use of reading strategies for comprehension.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
